title: Estimating Search Benefits from Path-Tracking Data: Measurement and Determinants
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional IV regression of price paid on search duration (instrumented by trip walking speed) with category FE, from RFID shopping-cart path data. No treatment adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: Package is a 7-zip archive (mksc.2017.1026.zip) not scanned by the inventory; analysis.do: areg price itempickuptime, abs(specific_category) (Table 2 col 1) and ivreg2 price i.specific_category (itempickuptime = speed_trip) (Tables 2-6), xtivreg2 with consumer FE (Table 3 col 7).
data_files: mksc.2017.1026.zip (7z): Sales.txt, Sale_Items.txt, Trips.txt, Trip_Points.txt, Trip_Point_ItemPickups.txt, price_series.dta, product_categories.dta, category_char.dta
data_files_note: Raw RFID path-tracking and sales data plus build do-files 1)-6); README.docx inside the 7z archive.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract from data/frame/mksc.jsonl read. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
